text:
Marta S: Heads up — noticed a big p99 step for hosted inference in eu-west1 this morning. Correlates with a small group of requests routed to rack9-node12.
Liam R: Seen it. Dashboard shows per-node token latency spike around 06:12 UTC, coincident with GPU powerlimit jitter and fan tach drop on node12. :eyes:
Marta S: Logs attached below (snips). dmesg shows repeated NVRM Xid entries.
Liam R: paste: `dmesg | tail -n 40` ->\nNVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 13, pid=22456, GPU a0 0000 0000\nNVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31\n(occurs ~10x)
Arjun K: Xid 13/31 sequence = ECC/soft-failure-ish or driver/static mem errors. Can be flaky card or power delivery problem. Also seeing NVML power draw oscillation in metrics.
Marta S: Example nvml query we ran: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,temperature.gpu,fan.speed,power.draw,power.limit --format=csv -l 1 -f /tmp/gpu-sample.csv` sample lines:\n"2026/02/18 06:11:59, 0, 78 C, 102 %, 285.12 W, 300 W"\n"2026/02/18 06:12:00, 0, 78 C, 0 %, 75.00 W, 300 W"\nSo fan/tach flip to 0 then power draw collapses then recovers. That correlates with the higher tail latencies.
Sasha (oncall): I'm oncall, starting triage. What's current load on that node? Can we drain before we suffer more tail latency/regressions? :fire:
Liam R: Current kube pod placements: 6 inference pods on gpu-rack9-node12, avg GPU util 45% but p99 token latency up 3-4x. Suggest immediate soft-drain and move live traffic via routing policy to rack8 pool.
Sasha (oncall): Starting drain with fleetctl. Command: `fleetctl drain gpu-rack9-node12 --reason "thermal/power oscillation" --mode soft` — kicking off now.
infra-bot: Scheduled: drain started for gpu-rack9-node12 by Sasha (oncall) at 1865129405. Rebalance job created: rb-1865129405-9. Monitor: https://infra.internal/rebalance/rb-1865129405-9
Arjun K: While draining, please capture full NVSM logs and sysfs sensor state. Commands I want run (non-blocking):\n1) `sudo cat /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/temp*_input`\n2) `sudo cat /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/fan*_input`\n3) `sudo journalctl -u nvidia-persistenced -n 200`\n4) `nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_gpu_memory --format=csv`\nAlso collect PCI power rails: `ipmitool sdr list | grep -i gpu` if available.
Marta S: Collected and uploaded to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1865129000/gpu-rack9-node12/*.gz
Liam R: Quick triage notes: PSU rails look stable from BMC, but local PMIC logs show transient undervolt entry at ~06:12:00 that lines up with fan tach drop. Hypothesis: fan tach glitch causes firmware to throttle or power-management state machine to reduce power briefly -> kernel/driver gets Xid noise -> tail latency spike.
Sasha (oncall): If hypothesis holds, replace fan assembly and run extended burn test. We'll mark node for maintenance window if soft-drain successful. Any preference for immediate replacement vs redeploy+monitor?
Arjun K: Replace hardware if we see repeatable fan tach=0 events after reboot + oob tests. For now, keep node in maintenance candidate list. Set autoscale fallback to use rack8 and rack11 for eu-west1.
Marta S: Post-drain telemetry: p99 back to normal after rebalance. Keeping node offline. Tagging ticket INC-2026-4812 and linking hardware request.
infra-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-4812: "rack9-node12 thermal/power oscillation causing Xid errors and inference tail latency" assigned to HW swap team. https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026-4812
Liam R: Extra: add alert rule to watch for simultaneous (fan.speed == 0 OR fan.input == 0) and nvml.power.draw drop > 50W within 5s and >3 Xid events in 1m. Silence if node is in maintenance.
Sasha (oncall): Confirmed. I'll submit the alert PR and add runbook steps for soft-drain + OOB tests. Runbook snippet:\n```
- On alert: check nvml and dmesg for Xid\n- Soft-drain node: `fleetctl drain`\n- Run `nvidia-smi --gpu-reset` (if supported) or reboot node\n- If event recurs after reboot, schedule hardware swap (fan/pmic/board)\n- Mark node as quarantine until validated
```
Marta S: Thanks team. Follow-ups: hw swap scheduled for tomorrow 02:00 UTC; we'll keep node offline until validated. Closing thread once swapped and p99 is stable for 24h. :thumbsup:
